title: acer orientale var. cuneifolium
intro: Acer orientale var. cuneifolium, commonly known as the Manchurian maple, is a plant species within the genus Acer. It is a deciduous tree known for its distinctive leaves and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Acer orientale var. cuneifolium include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
